name: @sderickson/recipes-deploy
description: Recipes deploy: the recipes monolith and web container. Joins the platform's (hub/deploy) edge and registers its routes there.

scripts.prod-local: sh ../../hub/deploy/scripts/prod-local-claim-edge.sh recipes-prod-local && . ./env.remote && export CONTAINER_REGISTRY && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod-local.yaml up --detach --remove-orphans && (cd ../../hub/deploy && saf-deploy register-sites --local) && saf-deploy register-sites --local && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod-local.yaml logs --follow --since 1m $(docker compose -f docker-compose.prod-local.yaml config --services | grep -v kratos-migrate)
